response.query: What minimum number of studies (k) and sample-size thresholds should we require to include a predictor in meta-analysis and to run meta-regressions?
response.answer: For meta-analysis, typically at least 3 studies (k=3) and a minimum sample size of 100 are required; for meta-regressions, at least 5 studies (k=5) are generally needed.

results.title: The association between body mass index, physical fitness and COVID-19 hospitalization among male active duty U.S. Army soldiers, May 2020–November 2021 | Health.mil
results.content: # The association between body mass index, physical fitness and COVID-19 hospitalization among male active duty U.S. Army soldiers, May 2020–November 2021. For male U.S. Army active duty soldiers, the association between having a higher BMI and COVID-19 hospitalization was amplified by age, indicating about a 1% increase in the odds of hospitalization per BMI unit for each additional year of age. Finally, when Army physical fitness test data within nine months following COVID-19 diagnosis, combined with body composition data during the same period, were assessed among the remaining study population sample, the cohort was reduced to a final number of 13,074, or 20.5 percent of the original population total.The population for this retrospective cohort study included U.S. Army active duty soldiers with measured heights and weights and either 1) documented history of initial COVID-19 or 2) history of initial COVID-19 hospitalization from May 1, 2020 through November 30, 2021.
